Docs only: replaced the XiaoyaoClaw promo line in SKILL.md with a bilingual XiaoyaoAI promo block (Chinese + English, project.xiaoyaosai.com). No functional, script, or metadata changes.

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Updated root directory compliance checks in SKILL.md: now explicitly checks for "no extra directories" (non-standard/system/hidden directories) in root, with aggregated hints.
- All other functionality and usage unchanged.

- Removed documentation and asset files: LICENSE, README (both English and Chinese), skill-card, design docs, and images.
- Core skill functionality and description remain unchanged.
- All removed information is still available via the linked GitHub repository.
- No changes to auditing or report generation logic.

- Added detailed skill description and usage documentation in SKILL.md, including supported health checks and boundaries.
- Clarified only-read functionality: the auditor strictly scans and reports, never modifies or deletes files.
- Listed all audit items (directory compliance, task health, memory/log gaps, KB orphan files, junk files), report severity levels, and repair suggestions.
- Described command-line usage for scan_workspace.py, customization options, and integration with related skills.
- Documented safety guarantees: offline, zero-dependency, and explicit user control over any repair actions.

Initial release of xiaoyaoclaw-workspace-auditor.

- Provides a read-only health audit for OpenClaw agent workspaces using a zero-dependency Python script.
- Checks directory structure, task progress (PROGRESS.md), memory-log gaps, knowledge-base index issues, and junk/large files.
- Outputs severity-graded (red/yellow/green) reports with repair suggestions.
- Designed as audit-only: strictly never modifies, deletes, or moves any files.
- Integrates with related OpenClaw tools but works independently to ensure audit boundaries.
